blocks.text: *Claudia* and *Louis* are visiting the zoo. They like to watch the animals very much. The zoo is a nice place for them to stay because they love all kinds of animals. There are many bushes around the zoo. The sun is shining. Claudia is in front of the monkeys’ cage. She’s throwing some peanuts trying to play with a little monkey. The little monkey eats and when he opens his mouth again it looks so funny. He smiles and claps with his feet and hands. It is really entertaining to spend a Sunday afternoon in the zoo.

lines: It lives in rivers and looks like a big lizard. It has a big tail and many teeth in its big mouth.

The tiger, like the lion, is a wild animal. It is strong too. It has a long tail. The Security Department of the zoo takes care of these animals especially at night to protect the others from a possible attack from the tigers.
Lions are strong animals. The mother or female lion lays down in a corner of the lions’ cage.
The elephant is one of the largest animals we know. It has a long nose. It is called a “trunk”. This elephant is in the zoo, but there are many elephants in the circus, too.

items: *L –* I’m hungry.
*C –* I’m hungry and thirsty. We were walking a lot. Why don’t we go to eat Mexican food!
*L –* That’s great, there’s a small, but very comfortable Mexican restaurant opposite the zoo, let’s go there.
*C –* Oh, I remember when we spent our honeymoon in Mexico, and we had some spicy food.
*L –* Yes darling, I remember all that happened there.
*C –* Well, what would you like to eat now?
*L –* I want a special taco and a small coke.
*C –* I want a taco with chili and some iced tea.
